bundle_sti/dist/sti_state.parquet|geogra.short_description: 2-digit state or territory FIPS code. 00 is national.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_state.parquet|time.short_description: Year end (YYYY-12-31) of the annual observation.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_state.parquet|measur.short_description: Measure the row's value belongs to.

chr_sexually_transmitted_infections.short_description: Number of newly diagnosed chlamydia cases per 100,000 population.

chr_hiv_prevalence.short_description: People aged 13+ living with diagnosed HIV per 100,000 population.

medicaid_chl_ch_pct_25.short_description: 25th percentile of the adolescent chlamydia screening rate across reporting states. The same value is repeated on every state row for the year.

medicaid_chl_ch_pct_75.short_description: 75th percentile of the adolescent chlamydia screening rate across reporting states. The same value is repeated on every state row for the year.

medicaid_chl_ad_pct_25.short_description: 25th percentile of the adult chlamydia screening rate across reporting states. The same value is repeated on every state row for the year.

medicaid_chl_ad_pct_75.short_description: 75th percentile of the adult chlamydia screening rate across reporting states. The same value is repeated on every state row for the year.

cms_scrn_prvnt_sti.short_description: Percent of Medicare Fee-for-Service beneficiaries with a claim for sexually transmitted infection screening during the year. Medicare FFS is mostly people 65 and older, so this is not comparable with the Medicaid or NNDSS measures.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_state.parquet|value.short_description: Value of the measure named in the measure column. Units differ by measure.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_county.parquet|geogr.short_description: 5-digit county FIPS code. Connecticut uses planning-region codes from 2023.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_county.parquet|time.short_description: Year end (YYYY-12-31) of the annual observation.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_county.parquet|measu.short_description: Measure the row's value belongs to.

chr_sexually_transmitted_infections.short_description: Number of newly diagnosed chlamydia cases per 100,000 population.

chr_hiv_prevalence.short_description: People aged 13+ living with diagnosed HIV per 100,000 population.

cms_scrn_prvnt_sti.short_description: Percent of Medicare Fee-for-Service beneficiaries with a claim for sexually transmitted infection screening during the year. Medicare FFS is mostly people 65 and older, so this is not comparable with the Medicaid or NNDSS measures.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_county.parquet|value.short_description: Value of the measure named in the measure column. Units differ by measure.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_quarterly.parquet|ti.short_description: Last day of the calendar quarter.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_quarterly.parquet|me.short_description: Measure the row's value belongs to.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_quarterly.parquet|va.short_description: Age-adjusted deaths per 100,000 population for the measure named in the measure column.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_weekly.parquet|geogr.short_description: 2-digit state or territory FIPS code. 00 is the national total.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_weekly.parquet|measu.short_description: Measure the row's value belongs to.

chlamydia_trachomatis_infection.short_description: Weekly number of Chlamydia trachomatis infection cases reported to NNDSS.

gonorrhea.short_description: Weekly number of gonorrhea cases reported to NNDSS.

syphilis_primary_and_secondary.short_description: Weekly number of primary and secondary syphilis cases reported to NNDSS.

syphilis_congenital.short_description: Weekly number of congenital syphilis cases reported to NNDSS.

chancroid.short_description: Weekly number of chancroid cases reported to NNDSS.

mpox.short_description: Weekly number of mpox cases reported to NNDSS. Reported to NNDSS from 2024.

hepatitis_b_acute.short_description: Weekly number of acute hepatitis B cases reported to NNDSS. Reported under this label through 2023; from 2024 NNDSS splits it into confirmed and probable columns.

hepatitis_b_acute_confirmed.short_description: Weekly number of confirmed acute hepatitis B cases reported to NNDSS. Reported from 2024; earlier years use the single unsplit column.

hepatitis_b_acute_probable.short_description: Weekly number of probable acute hepatitis B cases reported to NNDSS. Reported from 2024; earlier years use the single unsplit column.

hepatitis_b_chronic_confirmed.short_description: Weekly number of confirmed chronic hepatitis B cases reported to NNDSS. Reported from 2024.

hepatitis_b_chronic_probable.short_description: Weekly number of probable chronic hepatitis B cases reported to NNDSS. Reported from 2024.

hepatitis_b_perinatal_infection.short_description: Weekly number of perinatal hepatitis B infection cases reported to NNDSS. Reported under this label through 2023; from late 2023 NNDSS uses the confirmed column.

hepatitis_b_perinatal_confirmed.short_description: Weekly number of confirmed perinatal hepatitis B infection cases reported to NNDSS. Reported from late 2023.

hepatitis_c_acute_confirmed.short_description: Weekly number of confirmed acute hepatitis C cases reported to NNDSS.

hepatitis_c_acute_probable.short_description: Weekly number of probable acute hepatitis C cases reported to NNDSS.

hepatitis_c_chronic_confirmed.short_description: Weekly number of confirmed chronic hepatitis C cases reported to NNDSS. Reported from 2024.

hepatitis_c_chronic_probable.short_description: Weekly number of probable chronic hepatitis C cases reported to NNDSS. Reported from 2024.

hepatitis_c_perinatal_infection.short_description: Weekly number of perinatal hepatitis C infection cases reported to NNDSS. Reported under this label through 2023; from late 2023 NNDSS uses the confirmed column.

hepatitis_c_perinatal_confirmed.short_description: Weekly number of confirmed perinatal hepatitis C infection cases reported to NNDSS. Reported from late 2023.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_weekly.parquet|value.short_description: Weekly case count for the measure named in the measure column, derived by differencing CDC's cumulative year-to-date counts. Negative values are downward revisions by CDC. Measure-years with no national reporting are omitted.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_youth.parquet|geogra.short_description: 2-digit state FIPS code. 00 is national. New York excludes New York City.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_youth.parquet|time.short_description: Survey year, stored as YYYY-12-31. YRBSS runs in odd years.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_youth.parquet|age.short_description: Modal age for grade, from 14 for 9th grade to 17 for 12th grade, or Overall. Age rows have sex and race_ethnicity set to Overall.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_youth.parquet|value_.short_description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for value.
Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for value.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_youth.parquet|suppre.short_description: 1 if CDC suppressed the estimate (value and CI are NA), 0 otherwise.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_youth.parquet|measur.short_description: Measure the row's value belongs to.

bundle_sti/dist/sti_youth.parquet|value.short_description: Weighted percent of high school students for the measure named in the measure column. NA when CDC suppressed the estimate. Jurisdiction-years where the question was not asked are omitted.
